_comment: Reproduces what avni-client does on the test phone TODAY, from its synced server payload (logcat 'MeanTargetBgrRounded', 27 Oct 2026): resize=stretch interp=cubic round=1 rounding=legacy uint8Round=true ignoreColorProfile=false scale=1/255. Legacy rounding = float64 math + Java Math.round (half-up). Use it to show the SDK can match avni's current production bit-for-bit through JSON alone; sdk-config.default.json is the QC-notebook pipeline. Note: ignoreColorProfile=false only matters for Display-P3 photos (the SDK always reads stored pixel values); the test photos are sRGB.
_models_comment: Every model the SDK knows about. name = id used in reports and run_models. path = absolute path; placeholders ${FILES} (app-private, default), ${EXTERNAL_FILES}, ${CACHE}. engine = onnx | litert | auto. pipeline = which entry under 'pipelines' prepares its input and reads its output (may be omitted when only one pipeline exists). enabled (default true) = runs when run_models is absent. Optional: input_layout (CHW/HWC per-model override), sha256.

models._comment: LiteRT float32 exports of the same folds (onnx2tf, NCHW input kept; logits match ONNX within 1e-4). Need edgesdk.litert=true in gradle.properties. To use: enabled true here, false on the ONNX ones.
models.name: model6-tfl

_run_models_comment: Optional override. Absent = every model with enabled=true, in the order above. Present = exactly these names, in this order (enabled flags ignored), e.g. "run_models": ["model8", "model8-tfl"]. Unknown names fail on Apply.
_pipelines_comment: Named recipes. Each declares input (type + type-specific steps + the named, typed tensors it produces), output (how one model's raw output becomes a label) and combine (how the models sharing this pipeline are combined). Models of different pipelines never get combined with each other. input.type: image (implemented); text, audio, tensor are reserved for later.

input._decode_comment: apply_exif: rotate/flip upright from the photo's EXIF tag like cv2.imread (keep true; the sample photos are orientation 6). max_decode_side: 0 = full resolution (QC parity); N > 0 = decoder halves the image until its long side is between N and 2N (faster, less memory, no longer bit-identical to QC).
input._steps_comment: avni legacy: stretch (no letterbox), gray_world in float64, half-up rounding to 1 decimal, half-up to uint8, x float(1/255).
input._tensors_comment: What the steps produce for the model. An image pipeline produces exactly one float32 tensor. name = the model's input name (omit to bind by position). layout CHW|HWC, channel_order RGB|BGR, shape is checked.

oral-image._output_comment: decoder: sigmoid-binary (p = sigmoid(logit)) | softmax-argmax | raw. threshold_inclusive true = p >= threshold is positive (QC rule). labels: [negative, positive] or class names.
oral-image._combine_comment: unanimous-and (avni default: every model must say positive) | any-or | majority | mean-probability | none.

loading._comment: strategy = how the file reaches the runtime. path: runtime opens the file itself (recommended). mmap: FileChannel.map -> direct buffer (same memory as path for .onnx; ORT still copies weights natively). bytes: whole file into a Java ByteArray first (extra heap copy; baseline only). keep_loaded false = load, run, close each model per input (lowest peak memory, pays load time every time). warmup_runs 0-10 = untimed throw-away inferences the first time a loaded model is used; 0 shows the real first-scan time, 1 for fair speed comparisons.

onnx._comment: Applies to every engine=onnx model. Defaults copied from avni OnnxEngine (3 resident sessions on low-RAM phones). intra_op_threads: threads per inference. cpu_arena / memory_pattern: true = slightly faster repeat runs, more native memory held. optimization_level: none | basic | extended | all. execution_provider: cpu | xnnpack | nnapi. config_entries: raw ORT session keys, e.g. {"session.intra_op.allow_spinning": "0"}.

litert._comment: Applies to every engine=litert model. accelerator: cpu | gpu (gpu also needs the litert-gpu dependency, not added yet). LiteRT memory-maps the .tflite from its path.

diagnostics._comment: Test-bench extras, not needed in production. measure_pss: include process PSS in memory lines. verify_sha256: stream-hash model files on Validate. parity_trace: write a line-by-line trace of every intermediate value (input hash, decoded pixels, canvas, gray-world, tensor hash, logits) to <external files>/parity-traces/sdk-*.txt, in the same format as avni's debug build, for tools/parity/compare_traces.py. compare_with_reference: also run avni's Kotlin preprocessor on reference_pipeline (default: first image pipeline) with reference_params (= avni override 'input.params') and report tensor and logit differences.
